title: 学习机制项目中文总览：已有结果与最终远景
method: Export saved scalar results and redraw figures. No training, remote execution, or model/AD replication.

units.fractions: signed ratios, stored as fractions rather than percent

natural_all_parameter.training: Eight full-parameter SGD steps, learning rate2e-7, Cal64 training
natural_all_parameter.source_scope: Declared endpoint parameter line.17/128 refined per-source controls;111 original total closure controls. Signed path-dependent attribution.
natural_all_parameter.small_temperature_scope: Post-observation smaller grid; not new-data blind confirmation. Small-grid endpoints not independently replayed.

fixed_near_band.scope: Finite near-row response; no B stock or long-term dominance.

explicit_clock_short_window.scope: Explicit relative mobility intervention, not native pretraining clock. Original raw-score derivative audit failed; registered equivalent-gauge precision control passed.

profile_pair_derivative.scope: Conditional FP64 support/gradient/geometry model; all exact profile minimizers in the same centered 5% ball. No positive stock, future or continuous-flow qualification.

natural_restricted_family.continuous_native_flow_future: Finite backward-Euler future completed. Full-path continuous-flow qualification remains false.

future_prediction_windows.scope: Separate preregistered windows and initial anchors; no concatenation into one forecast.

controlled_CE.scope: Controlled binary CE; normalized two-candidate gap constant2, does not reproduce the zero-normalized-gap premise or natural text.

conditional_task_classes.scope: Conditional final-task boundary classes; not all-task quantization.
